question_en: How many students are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students;

question_en: How many students are in year 3?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE year = 3;

question_en: How many courses are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses;

question_en: How many students major in Physics?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE major = 'Physics';

question_en: How many instructors are in the Business department?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instructors WHERE department = 'Business';

question_en: How many enrollments are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments;

question_en: List the titles of all Computer Science courses.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE department = 'Computer Science';

question_en: Which courses are worth 6 credits?
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE credits = 6;

question_en: How many enrollments have a grade above 90?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE grade > 90;

question_en: What is the highest grade ever recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(grade) FROM enrollments;

question_en: How many enrollments were in Fall 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE semester = 'Fall 2025';

question_en: How many students are enrolled in Databases?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Databases';

question_en: How many enrollments are in Computer Science courses?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.department = 'Computer Science';

question_en: How many year 1 students are enrolled in Calculus I?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.year = 1 AND c.title = 'Calculus I';

question_en: How many Biology majors took Genetics?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.major = 'Biology' AND c.title = 'Genetics';

question_en: How many different students did Statistics have in Spring 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Statistics' AND e.semester = 'Spring 2025';

question_en: What is the average grade in Machine Learning?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.grade), 1) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Machine Learning';

question_en: How many students are in each year?
gold_sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY year;

question_en: How many students are there per major?
gold_sql: SELECT major, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY major;

question_en: What is the average grade per course department?
gold_sql: SELECT c.department, ROUND(AVG(e.grade), 1) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.department;

question_en: How many enrollments are still in progress?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE grade IS NULL;

question_en: How many students have at least one enrollment in progress?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM enrollments WHERE grade IS NULL;

question_en: How many Computer Science majors have an enrollment in progress?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE s.major = 'Computer Science' AND e.grade IS NULL;

question_en: How many students have never scored below 60 in any course?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments WHERE grade < 60);

question_en: How many in-progress enrollments are in Computer Science courses?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.department = 'Computer Science' AND e.grade IS NULL;

question_en: How many instructors have taught more than 30 enrollments?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT instructor_id FROM enrollments GROUP BY instructor_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 30);

question_en: Which course department has the highest average grade?
gold_sql: SELECT c.department FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY c.department ORDER BY AVG(e.grade) DESC LIMIT 1;

question_en: How many students have taken at least 5 courses?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5);

question_en: What is the average grade of Computer Science majors?

question_en: How many enrollments are there in each semester?

question_en: What is the average grade in Spring 2026?

question_en: How many students have an average grade above 75?
